declared_changes.detail: goal at 6:50 of P1 credited to Timo Meier, later credited to Dawson Mercer

notes: The goal was scored 3:46 into the first period (clock 6:50). Both official sources (report and play-by-play) show the same corrected credit; both are consistent with the league's announcement. The pre-change credit for the SCORER rests on the syndicated reproduction only, and the pre-change ASSIST credits are not retrievable at all, so the full scope of this correction is unresolved. A public reply on the announcement post asks why a Chicago player lost an assist; no official source reviewed here records a Chicago credit on this goal at any point, and the reply is a public comment, not evidence. It is logged as an open question for human review. This correction does not change the number of goals in the game (NJD 5 - CHI 3 before and after); it changes which player is credited, so it can only touch player-prop markets.
